Security > Authentication

Customers authenticate with an email address and a password. A session token expires after one hour of inactivity and must be refreshed against the backend.

The frontend never stores a password, and the backend stores only a salted hash.

Security > Authorisation

A customer may read only their own orders. An operations user may read any order but may never place one on a customer's behalf.

Authorisation is enforced in the backend, never in the frontend.
